Skyler Gill-Howard (born October 13, 2002) is a professional American football defensive tackle for the Detroit Lions of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for Upper Iowa, the Northern Illinois Huskies, and Texas Tech Red Raiders. Gill-Howard was selected by the Lions in the sixth round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
Early life and high school
Gill-Howard attended Greenfield High School located in Greenfield, Wisconsin. Coming out of high school, he committed to play college football at Upper Iowa.
College career
Throughout his four-year college career from 2022 through 2025, Gill-Howard totaled 88 tackles with 14.5 going for a loss, six and a half sacks, and an interception.
